["From: Eamon
To: Lark
Subject: Request: sail canvas

Hope the week is going well. Please arrange 435 rolls of sail canvas for me by Friday. The heating in the yard office is still off.

From: Ulric
To: Lark
Subject: Odds and ends

I saw that the window frames in the print room were aired out. Odette relabelled the map drawers in the loading bay at the start of the month. Ivo tidied the light fittings in the loading bay just before closing. Vesna mentioned the print room at the start of the month. Dalia asked whether the west annex could be inventoried just before closing. Quilla mentioned the cellar this morning. Sabine mentioned the back corridor this morning. The filing cabinets near the yard office still need to be swept. I saw that the door hinges in the print room were aired out. I saw that the window frames in the print room were aired out. Lark asked whether the garden shed could be repainted before the meeting. Corin asked whether the front desk could be measured before the meeting. I saw that the coat hooks in the cellar were photographed. I saw that the filing cabinets in the west annex were aired out. Juno mentioned the west annex just before closing. Brisa mentioned the cellar just before closing. Vesna measured the notice boards in the front desk late in the afternoon. The notice boards near the upper landing still need to be photographed. The door hinges near the cellar still need to be photographed. I saw that the seed trays in the print room were inventoried. I saw that the storage racks in the back corridor were dusted. Maren asked whether the yard office could be repainted after lunch. Ivo asked whether the print room could be photographed this morning. Quilla aired out the stair rails in the boiler room before the meeting. Ysolde aired out the window frames in the loading bay before the meeting. Maren repainted the window frames in the west annex late in the afternoon. Ulric dusted the map drawers in the back corridor late in the afternoon. Quilla mentioned the reading room late in the afternoon.

From: Ulric
To: Lark
Subject: Small update

Tamsin asked whether the yard office could be repainted late in the afternoon. I saw that the door hinges in the back corridor were measured. Lark
